acceptance: An adoption PR whose CI and review verdict pass is armed without a manual dispatch and without waiting for the next scheduled run.
The re-arm path refuses a PR not owned by the delivery App, a moved head, a human hold or a human disarm, with tests.
The kill switch off and dry-run paths perform no arm.
description:
Problem. .github/workflows/sqlglot-delivery.yml runs daily at 06:37 UTC and on dispatch. The run that opens the App-authored adoption PR calls arm immediately, which correctly refuses because CI and the review verdict have not finished. Nothing re-arms the PR when they complete, so the PR sits until the next daily run, up to 24 h later. Observed on #3997 (30.30.0.1): the opening run 42326742524 reported not-armed (no verify-fast-duration verdict, no review verdict); arming happened only after a second manual dispatch (run 42331547173), which armed and merged it. This adds a day of latency to every release and makes a manual dispatch the routine fast path, which the first-release certification forbids.

Change. Re-attempt arming of an open automation-owned adoption PR when its CI and review verdict complete, for example a workflow_run or check_suite trigger that runs only the arm step with the same ownership and live re-validation rules. Keep the kill switch, dry-run default and the rule that a human hold or disarm is never overridden.
